function.name: run_fss
function.description: Run the fss command-line tool and return its stdout, stderr and exit code. Pass the arguments after 'fss' as a list, e.g. ["check", "https://example.com", "--format", "json"]. Add --format json to every command except identify. Never pass --apply, --force, --full, --refresh, --prune or --update unless the user has just agreed to it.

args.description: Arguments after 'fss', one per element. The first is the command: check, detect, scrape, list-scrapers, list-studios, compare, doctor, version, identify, creators, config, stash.
